cells.gaps: The 728 schools are the press's and the vendor's count of schools using Xgest, with no level named (read as primary) and no total, so no share. `kept` disagrees: marks and results in Xgest at 27 September 2024 (GAB-015) against the ministry's order of 24 September 2024 that no personal data pass through it (GAB-017) and the once-a-year learner identification of 2025/2026 (GAB-010), which does not say whether school or family makes the entry. No count of schools in the SOSUP register; plan and finance not stated; Xgest itself is vendor-owned (GAB-016).
cells.note: Xgest is in live use in 728 schools for marks and results and the ministry's learner identification runs nationally across primary and secondary, which is past a pilot. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary schools entering attendance or results on a share or a count with its total; a count of schools using the system with no total is not that.
